message:
Now I understand the fuzz harness. The `lint.c` fuzz target uses `xmllintMain` with various switches. The `--htmlout` switch would trigger HTML output processing. Let me check how `xmllint.c` handles `--htmlout` and how it calls `htmlSaveFileFormat`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -n "htmlSaveFileFormat\|htmlSaveFile\|htmlDocDump\|--htmlout\|htmlout" xmllint.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜function>
